elena_ml: Heads-up — after the FP8 rollout to canary we started seeing structured-output failures and higher hallucination rates on the eval suite. spotted around 16:35 UTC.

elena_ml: Quick summary from the eval job: hallucination_rate went from 6.1% -> 9.4% (absolute +3.3%). JSON parse errors for the structured-output test increased from 0.6% -> 4.7%.

tyler_runtime: ack. do we have a repro prompt + model/version?

elena_ml: yes — repro set: eval_struct_json_v2 (300 prompts). Model: redwood-13b-mix-fp8:v2026-03-10. Repro locally with dedicated canary cluster.

sam_kernel: my first guess is FP8 quantization calibration producing off-by-one shifts in some softmax layers when KV cache is used for multi-turn. That can change token probabilities and break strict JSON outputs.

anya_eval: attaching a couple of failing examples inline: 
1) expected: {"action":"open","file":"README.md"} got: "open file readme" (loose text)
2) expected nested JSON, got extra key name mangled and trailing characters -> parse error

sam_kernel: sharing quick profiler output from a canary run (truncated):
```
kernel_select_time_ms: 24.7 -> 68.3  # before -> after fp8 rollout
kv_cache_copy_ms: 3.2 -> 4.1
attn_softmax_variance: +0.9% mean
dtype_path_taken: fp8_kernel (72%), fallback-int8 (28%)
```

tyler_runtime: interesting — kernel_select_time jump is big. could be hitting a fallback path often which has different numerical behavior. any pattern by sequence length?

elena_ml: pattern: regressions concentrated on multi-turn prompts with total seq length > 512 and heavy reuse of KV cache (chat-style). single-turn generation is mostly fine.

sam_kernel: hypothesis: when KV cache slices are not aligned to the kernel's preferred tile size, we do an unoptimized memory copy + use a fallback kernel that does slightly different quant dequant ordering. FP8 rounding error compounded across timesteps -> structured output breaks.

tyler_runtime: reproduce plan: 1) run single-session reproducer with and without KV cache enabled; 2) force different kernel selection via env var to compare pure-fp8 vs fallback-int8; 3) run per-layer calibration dump. I'll take (1) and (2).

anya_eval: I'll re-run the eval harness with debug logging (json-assert mode) and attach failing prompt ids.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: started canary rollback to v2026-03-08 for model variant redwood-13b-mix-fp8 on cluster canary-2 (ETA 8m).

elena_ml: For now let's pause the wider FP8 rollout until we bisect. Important decision: we should NOT ship FP8 for sequences > 512 until we confirm KV alignment safe.

sam_kernel: actions I'm taking:
- add KV padding aligner to runtime that can force pad to 64-token tiles for FP8 kernels (local patch).
- add a microbench to measure numeric drift: run 100 prompts, compare logits between fp32->fp8->dequant and baseline fp32; compute L1/Linf per-layer.

tyler_runtime: I'll add an automated canary check in the rollout pipeline: for any FP8 candidate, run eval_struct_json_v2 and chat_repro set with KV enabled; require delta hallucination < 0.5% and json-parse errors < 1.0%.

anya_eval: initial micro-repro results (quick run):
- FP8 kernel with current calibration: hallucination +3.0%
- FP8 kernel with per-layer refined calibration: hallucination +0.6%
- FP8 + KV-pad-64: hallucination +0.4%
So padding + better calibration looks promising.

elena_ml: great. priority: get that per-layer calibration into the quant pipeline and add KV-pad as an opt-in flag. We need a test that fails if structured JSON error increases. plz file tickets.

sam_kernel: ticketed: RH-2318 add-kv-pad-and-tile-align for fp8 kernels; RH-2319 quant-per-layer-calibration-dump; RH-2320 numeric-drift-microbench.

tyler_runtime: I'll update rollout gating: block FP8 on production groups until RH-2318 & RH-2319 are merged and canary passes.

anya_eval: leaving some failing prompt ids in the eval board: EV-8791..EV-8810. I'll attach diffs and example parses.

elena_ml: follow-ups: 1) sam to send patch by EOD 2) tyler to update gating and rollback canary if not green in 24h 3) anya to run full eval with per-layer calibration when patch ready.

sam_kernel: working on patch now. pushing to branch fp8-kvpad-2026. I'll drop a link when done.

elena_ml: thanks — @tyler_runtime @anya_eval keep me posted. :thumbsup:
